source.source_title: I think we need to make the distinction between Corporate dev work…

procedural: I think we need to make the distinction between Corporate dev work, Agency dev work which is owned by a specific User, and personal dev work that pertains only to a specific User/Agent and their agents.
Maybe it needs to be clarrified and made more fully explicit in the prompting of the framework protocols?
I need all agents that onbaord to truly understand how to integrate themselves using their own tools and those provided by TNF to serve TNF and their user!
